extension.summary: Install Roc builds from Roc Repo
extension.description: Pick a build and a tier for this device. Every build opens a preview gallery first, with the install action at the top. Installs are fingerprint-verified (SHA-256) before anything is applied, your current setup is backed up first, and the installer finishes the job itself: addons switched on, Roc OS skin set, security lockdown applied. Trakt ships installed but off — sign in once, in one sitting, after the build settles.
Heavily restructured, advanced version of the original Internet Archive addon to watch and listen to media archived by Internet Archive
extension.disclaimer: This third party addon is not in any way commissioned or endorsed by Internet Archive

extension.summary: Roc OS — Eric's personal broadcast control room
extension.description: Roc OS is Eric's personal broadcast control room: a poster-forward home (Continue Watching + Trending rows over the build's own art, one clean floating dock), rooms that open straight onto the content — Cinema Room grids for Movies/TV, the War Room for Sports, a Music Room of songs and videos — and a floating glass panel that reads any title you rest on: poster, story, ratings, before you ever click. Kodi is the engine. Roc OS is the car.

extension.summary: Roc OS helper: PIN gate, daypart clock, focus memory, VPN surface
extension.description: The engine room of Roc OS (skin.rocos). Runs as a service: keeps the Day/Midday/Night wallpaper on the clock, remembers the last focused item per window and restores it on return, publishes the real VPN tunnel state to the dock shield, and gates the adult door behind a PIN that Eric sets himself on the device (stored only as a salted PBKDF2 hash in this addon's profile data).
extension.news: 0.7.2 - Bundle (2026-11-12): (1) seed roc_rocplay.json carries the player lane's relaxed asserts (movie [] / episode [season, episode]) so seed-repair can never revert the empty-box fix; (2) carries the Nov-11 bedroom ROC-GATEFIX (NL-verdict grace 1800 s + 2 extra egress endpoints + lookup timeout 4→8 s) which the 2.0.26 work tree did not contain — bedroom keeps its live gate behaviour, fleet-wide. Nothing else changes vs 0.7.1. 0.6.8 - VPN region readout + transition states + Home fix button (2026-11-10, file-side only, NOT deployed -- waits for Eric's launch word): publish_vpn_state now also publishes RocVPN.Region (full name) / RocVPN.RegionCode / RocVPN.Phase / RocVPN.Target / RocVPN.TargetOK / RocVPN.Display. REGION: the tunnel's real exit country from an egress-IP geolocation lookup made THROUGH the tunnel (https://ipapi.co/json/, https://ipwho.is/ fallback; keyless HTTPS; a verdict needs a 2-letter code AND a country name; a region is never guessed). Cache law (vpn_region_cache.json): a verified region is trusted 300s; any publish that sees the tunnel down destroys the cached region verdict (phase/fix bookkeeping survives); failed lookups retry at most once a minute. PHASE (display-only; detect_vpn_state and the gate are untouched): 'connected' when the tunnel carries traffic; 'connecting' when a real tunnel interface exists with no traffic yet and has been in that shape under 120s (a stalled tunnel falls back to the settled word); 'disconnecting' is deliberately NOT rendered -- teardown removes the interface and interface-down is indistinguishable from a dead tunnel, so the poll source cannot prove it. DISPLAY (Eric's abbreviation call: codes, not whole words): on+NL 'VPN ● NL', on+elsewhere 'VPN ● <CODE>' (said plainly, on purpose -- the honest words are the alarm), on+unverified 'VPN on', connecting 'VPN connecting… <CODE>' when the target is honestly known else 'VPN connecting…', off 'VPN off', unknown 'VPN ?'. The connecting target is named ONLY for a fix-button request (fix_target=NL, 600s) -- a connect started inside Proton names no target, because Proton's chosen country is not readable from here. New action=vpn_fix (skin 2.0.22 Home button 944): marks the region cache pending, records the fix target, fires vpn_switch_hook, then republishes, so the readout re-verifies through the live tunnel and can never render an unconfirmed success. THE SWITCH HOOK IS AN OPEN JOINT: today it binds to opening Proton VPN itself (proton_vpn) -- a silent in-place switch is NOT claimed, because Android reserves VPN control to the VPN app and Proton's Fire TV app exposes no verified connect-to-country intent; the VPN fix lane's proven direct mechanism, when its on-device record lands, binds inside vpn_switch_hook only. 0.6.7 - K16 enforcement (2026-11-09, file-side only, NOT deployed -- waits for Eric's launch word): the rocui service's TMDb Helper defaults enforcement (_enforce_tmdbh_defaults in service.py) now also enforces trakt_playprogress=true, in the same setSetting pass as the existing 6 player-default keys, so every profile carries it true by construction at service start instead of keeping the Helper's shipped false default (which silently stopped ResumeTime/TotalTime ever being stamped -- QC item K16, Nue playprogress divergence). No other key is touched and trakt_token is NOT touched by code -- the Trakt sign-in under Nue's profile remains a hands-side launch step. 0.6.6 - August search filter (2026-11-09, file-side only, NOT deployed -- waits for Eric's launch word): new ?mode=search directory (timeline.py build_search: keyboard prompt when no q, then results in the same invocation) serving rocui's own TMDB search through the new rocui_common.search_items -- each result's US certification is joined per id (tmdb_get detail + release_dates/content_ratings through the existing _detail_mpaa extractor, cached in search_certs.json like title_info.json; a failed fetch is not cached and stays hidden) and ONLY the allowed set {TV-Y, TV-Y7, TV-Y7-FV, TV-G, TV-PG, G, PG} is served: over-line (PG-13/TV-14/TV-MA/R/NC-17), unrated and unverifiable titles are dropped BEFORE any item is added, in original search order, filter-then-paginate (up to 3 TMDB pages per call, next-page row resumes at the first unfetched page). Rows are folders into ?mode=detail&coll=search, resolved by the new search sibling branch in open_collection_title's movierow synthesis gate (from the item's own TMDB stamps; the Helper's search is never called). A gate error reads as walled (toonime wrapper semantics); empty / all-filtered / API-down ends the directory cleanly with a notification. No search-history rows are served on this route (August loses the Helper history convenience there -- stated, not hidden). Content type: movies for tmdb_type=movie, tvshows for tv. AUDIT-MASTER.json is NOT the data join (it covers only the 287 shelf titles; joining it would hide nearly the whole catalog). 0.6.5 - Archive fix (2026-11-09, file-side only, NOT deployed -- waits for Eric's launch word): new rocui_ia module serves the Internet Archive doors in-house over archive.org's documented public APIs (advancedsearch.php + the Metadata API -- never the retired add-on's undocumented beta endpoint): timeline.py gains modes ia_search (no q = keyboard prompt then results; folders born IsPlayable=false into ia_item; services/img thumbs; 100 per page + next-page row), ia_item (playable file leaves), ia_play (deterministic click-and-play resolve from cached metadata to the file's https archive.org URL: original source first, then h.264/.mp4, then greatest height; audio .mp3/.flac by size), ia_lt and ia_root (Fringe menu: Search Video / Search Audio / the ported collection list as data). Junk filters ported from the retired add-on (the _has_playable_media format check everywhere; the movie NOT-list + 45-minute duration floor ONLY on interactive search results -- baked panels keep pure keyword semantics). Content types: ia_search video = videos, audio = songs; ia_lt = movies. New baked dataset resources/data/lt_shorts.json: the Classic Looney Tunes shelf from item ltmm-publicdomain -- 123 distinct public-domain shorts, 1929-1943, each with its original encode, h.264 derivative (9 shorts ship none) and a real .thumbs/ still; Eric's strike list (work/lt_strike.txt, empty) is applied by the generator. Also: timeline.py's _params helper, called by main() but never defined in the shipped tree, is defined (parse_qsl) so plugin invocations dispatch again. 0.6.4 - Toonime fix (2026-11-09, file-side only, NOT deployed -- waits for Eric's launch word): hub 1122 shelves are served by rocui itself from the sealed catalog resources/data/toonime_shelves.json (generated from AUDIT-MASTER.json only: 270 of 287 titles in play, every removed_by_eric title held out) -- new ?mode=toonime directory (timeline.py build_toonime_shelf; anime-movies declares movies content, the TV shelves tvshows), toonime_shelf_items with the mechanical kid rule (kid iff TV-Y/TV-Y7/TV-Y7-FV/TV-G/G; the 5 TV-PG titles are kid=false; under KidsWall kid-flagged titles only; unknown shelf or unreadable gate fails safe, never unfiltered), and the toonime- branch in open_collection_title resolving from the shelf data only. The classics-faith collection is removed with its COLLECTION_ORDER and KidsWall allowlist entries (Eric's Christian/religious category cut; Donut Man / McGee and Me! / Colby's Clubhouse appear nowhere in COLLECTIONS). Anime is one merged shelf (Anchors + US-run canon first, then the broader canon). 0.6.3 - Wrestling section removal (2026-11-09, file-side only, NOT deployed -- waits for Eric's launch word): the WWE timeline engine is removed from rocui_common (load_timeline and friends, timeline_prime/jump, the service scrubber tick in service.py, the default.py prime/jump actions); timeline.py loses its years rail (build_years/build_year) -- bare/unknown modes now end as an empty directory; the 4 era collections + their reps + the COLLECTION_ORDER wrestling key are removed; the shipped resources/data/ppv_events.json copy no longer ships (the canonical 447-event dataset stays in the workspace records). August Music, collections, movie rows, history/continue unchanged. 0.6.2 - Fix pass (2026-11-09, file-side only, NOT deployed -- waits for Eric's launch word): L4-D5 folder-diversion rebuilt wide + loud (roc-log probe dump on every no-tmdb stage_open; diverts on IsPlayable==false alone; stage_folder keeps its plugin:// safety); hub preview id-space fix (service PREVIEW_WINDOWS now dual-space -- previews could never start on custom hubs); WWE timeline event items route to RocWWE instead of the broken/removed Purely Wrestling; hub-route detail backfill now also publishes the US MPAA rating (release_dates/content_ratings appended, _detail_mpaa fill -- closes the PROOF-159 C8 trailing-gap). 0.6.1 - Publish train Leg 3 (2026-11-09): the .159-proven merged build published to the fleet channel (merged rocui_common.py: Music L4-D5 + Leftovers L4-D1/D2/D8 union). 0.6.0 — THE GATE (Eric's law, 2026-11-05): on any stick on the Roc Repo channel, nothing plays in 2 states — (1) the VPN tunnel is not confirmed on, (2) a Roc Repo update is pending. The gate (new rocui_gate module, run by the service) compares installed Roc add-on versions against the channel's addons.xml at login and every 30 minutes, applies a pending update itself, and holds playback (route refusal + a service watchdog that stops any playback started by any route, previews included) until the update lands. A pending verdict is persisted, so a restart is not a skip. Repo unreachable with no pending verdict on file = update leg stays open (a no-network stick must not brick itself); VPN unconfirmed always blocks. Verdict published as Window(10000) RocGate.* properties for the skin. 0.5.17 — Stage 2 skin wiring (Player Fix Lane, 2026-11-05, file-side; deploy in an announced session; ON-STICK PROOF STILL OWED on .159 — nothing here has run on hardware): (1) Detail PLAY (TV) now routes through detail_main_play when script.rocui is present (Helper-direct play stays as the fallback when it is absent); movie and no-TmdbId branches unchanged. The 8001 label now reads RocStage.MainLabel (PLAY vs CONTINUE WATCHING) with a PLAY fallback, and stage_open/open_collection_title publish fresh Main* props for movies too, so a movie opened after a show can no longer inherit a stale CONTINUE WATCHING label. (2) New detail_resume_play action for the detail RESUME button: position and source come from the per-title history and per-title source memory for THIS title/episode (TV via show_progress_target, movies via the newest matching history entry under the same 45s/2% floors and 97%/90s finished rule) — the one-title global resume checkpoint is never consulted, so resuming a different title than last-played can no longer resume the wrong title; fallback is exactly the button's old PlayMedia(RocStage.Path) with the seek armed when a position is known. (3) Detail SOURCES (TV) now passes season/episode to TMDb Helper play_using=select when both are staged (verified against Helper 5.4.16's own code on disk: play_using forwards season/episode into Players, which builds the play_episode route from them; whether the live Helper+RocPlay pair actually offers the episode on .159 is still on-stick-unverified); movie branch unchanged, and a TV title without staged season/episode keeps the old no-param call. (4) Movies hub 1111: IN THEATERS NOW and COMING SOON rows plus both VIEW MORE buttons now point at plugin://script.rocui/?mode=movierow&list=now_playing|upcoming (date-gated in 0.5.15/0.5.16) instead of the Helper's unfiltered info=now_playing/info=upcoming pass-through. NOT in this build: no SEASONS button — the 0.5.10 news implies one and detail_seasons exists, but no SEASONS control exists in the skin and none was added here; the TMDb Helper toast A/B/C pick is still Eric's, unanswered. Deploy notes carried from 0.5.16: the auto=1 player template only lands if the seeded roc_rocplay.json in TMDb Helper's players folder is replaced or deleted. 0.5.16 — Player Fix Lane, CONSOLIDATED build (merges the two 0.5.15 hand builds, Hand A items 1+4 and Hand B items 2a/2b/2c/3a/3b; file-side; deploy in an announced session): (1) Shows sources fix — stage_open and open_collection_title now mirror the computed TV target (fresh S1E1 / resume / next) into RocStage.Season/Episode when the staged item carried none, so the shipped detail window's PLAY button renders for show-level titles and fires Helper play with a real season/episode (0.5.14 published both empty for series posters; the detail PLAY TV branch gates on Episode, so a show page showed SOURCES only and that route dies in the Helper player assert). Episode rows that carry Season/Episode are never overwritten. (2) Movies hub rows date-gated — new rocui_common.movie_row_items + timeline ?mode=movierow&list=upcoming|now_playing serve COMING SOON / IN THEATERS NOW filtered on each title's primary release_date (upcoming: after today; now_playing: within 45 days up to today), replacing the Helper's verbatim TMDB /movie/upcoming + /movie/now_playing pass-through that admitted re-release antiques (Dune 2021/2024 and A Beautiful Mind 2001 in COMING SOON, Nightmare Before Christmas 1993 in IN THEATERS NOW on .155, 2026-11-05); skin content-path swap is the wiring step. (3) Hand B, same pass: Roc Play auto-play — player templates now send auto=1 so one click fans out and plays the first healthy source with no picker (picker stays reachable from the OSD SOURCES button via the new rocui_playback.source_select route); per-title source memory (source_memory.json) so resume/detail-play returns to the remembered source at the remembered position instead of re-running the full hunt; service fullscreen enforcer (ActivateWindow(fullscreenvideo) once per file, >4s in) restoring Select-to-OSD and the seek bar/time; seek applier reworked so a pending seek survives failover and is re-applied per attempt (expiry 600s to 1200s); final checkpoint on stop writes the exact leave position. DEPLOY NOTE: the auto=1 player template only lands on sticks if the seeded roc_rocplay.json in TMDb Helper players folder is replaced or deleted — existing sticks already hold the old file. Skin 2.0.9 (separate tree): dock UP chain repaired (dock to stage row to search bar), self-loop onups removed; new sounds/ package (nav/select/back ticks) so the skin is self-sufficient for click sounds. 0.5.13 — TV collection-detail fix (Loop 131, file-side; deploy in an announced session): open_collection_title now ends the plugin directory (succeeded=False, collection page stays underneath) BEFORE activating the detail window (1124), with a bounded 20-attempt activation retry. 0.5.12 activated from inside the outstanding directory call, while Kodi still held its busy dialog for that call, and the activation was refused as long as that modal dialog was up (10x cross-session for TV titles on the Classics-WB page, Loops 128/130, while the faster movie call opened in the same run) — the discriminator is call duration inside the directory dispatch, not TV code, since the TV branch runs after activation. Every return path ends the directory exactly once. stage_open is byte-untouched. 0.5.12 — Collection-page click fix, round 3 (Loop 122, file-side; deploy in an announced session): a collection page's title rows are folders into this plugin's own detail mode, and the new open_collection_title performs the stage_open-identical RocStage publish into the detail window (1124). The 0.5.7 leaf carrying the TMDb Helper details route could never be dispatched by the Videos window's built-in activation (not a folder, no IsPlayable) and the route itself only returns Helper's basedir listing — the click was inert by construction (Loops 110/118/119b). Everything else is 0.5.11 unchanged. 0.5.11 — Collection-page click fix (Loop 117, file-side; deploy in an announced session): plugin directories for title collections now declare movies/tvshows content instead of "videos", so the skin's primary Videos list (panel 50) renders them -- with "videos" panel 50 was invisible, defaultcontrol 50 failed to focus, and the fallback view's items did not activate on ENTER/DPAD_CENTER (Loop 110 step 5). Collections tiles pages for movies/tv categories declare their type the same way; every other directory is unchanged. 0.5.10 — Resume-PLAY detail fix (Loop 116, file-side; deploy in an announced session): detail_main_play now wins the show-page main button whenever stage_open published a resume target, so warm show titles no longer route to Helper with enriched latest Season/Episode infolabels (Loop 110's 3/25 AttributeError); the detail label shows the published target even when Episode infolabels are present; SEASONS button visibility matches detail_seasons()'s guard (TV title + TmdbId) so it renders for streamed shows, hidden only where the RESUME button shows (same spot); the detail_main_play success toast is removed per Eric 2026-11-02 06:49. 0.5.9 — Resume-PLAY skin wiring, rocui half: new detail_seasons action drives the season/episode dialogs from the detail page itself (RocStage.TmdbId, nothing playing required) for the skin SEASONS button built alongside it; detail_main_play and all 0.5.8 behaviour unchanged. 0.5.8 — Resume-PLAY (Eric Nov 1 10:07/10:32): the show-page main button now follows progress — no progress reads PLAY and starts S1E1, progress reads CONTINUE WATCHING and resumes his spot, a credits-reached episode reads CONTINUE WATCHING the NEXT episode. The target is computed from the playback history store (both profile and master stores are read, newest collapsed entry wins; finished = remaining <= 90s or pct >= 97%; progress counts only above 45s and 2%), recomputed fresh at click time by the new detail_main_play action, and published by stage_open as RocStage.MainLabel/Target props for TV titles. Skin Detail wiring (label $INFO + onclick + seasons button) is a separate file change and is NOT in this build. Movies keep their PLAY+RESUME pair. 0.5.7 — Poster-click route rework: a collection's titles are now served as real title posters (TMDB poster art plus the title's tmdb_id/tmdb_type as item properties) whose click path is that title's own TMDb Helper details route — no search fallback for a poster (a title that cannot resolve is left off the shelf and retries next build), and the rows are leaf items, not folders, so the click opens the title instead of navigating into a listing. Collection tiles still open their collection, whose page now renders those posters. Everything 0.5.6 carried is unchanged: the typed tmdb_type routes, the Roc Play player seed, and the Trakt slug living only in the trakt_user_slug setting. 0.5.6 — Trakt identity scrub: the Trakt user slug is no longer carried in the code. It is read from this addon's own trakt_user_slug setting (empty by default): on Eric's fleet a settings seed dropped into the addon's profile data at deploy time keeps his Trakt collections working; anywhere else the Trakt shelves simply do not appear. No other behaviour changes — the 0.5.5 click-route fix and the Roc Play player seed are unchanged. 0.5.5 — Click-route fix: every title link into TMDb Helper now carries the tmdb_type its 5.4.16 routes require (0.5.4's untyped search URL raised a TypeError inside the Helper — the error toast that killed every collection title click on the room stick); titles that resolve to a TMDB id open that title's own Helper page directly instead of a search; Discovery and the source re-pick fallback are typed the same way; and the service seeds the Roc Play player file into TMDb Helper's players folder when absent (never overwriting an existing one) so the play hop has its player on fresh installs. 0.5.1 — Collections art fix: stage collection tiles carry a representative title's TMDB poster as poster+thumb art (resolved via the addon's TMDB mini-client, cached in the profile data) instead of the badge alone, which the row layouts never render. 0.5.0 — v3.4.0 THE LOOK PASS: per-profile playback history store (Adult Continue Watching / History shelves + per-category stage Continue Watching ride it), the Collections engine for the stage's second row (Eric's named collections only: his Trakt lists, the Classics catalog, the wrestling eras, horror, Herbie), and the stage_folder click route for collection tiles. 0.4.0 — v3.3.0 THE AUDIT PASS (Roc Log, discovery honest core, Proton VPN route, install_app routes, mode_set). 0.2.0 — Phase 3: WWE Timeline engine — the 447-event WWF/WWE PPV/PLE index (1990-2026) ships as resources/data/ppv_events.json and is served to the War Room scrubber (years rail + per-year events, date order) via a plugin source in this addon; the service also syncs the scrubber's rested year to the events pane. 0.1.0 — Phase 2: adult PIN gate (set-on-first-use, salted hash), automatic Day/Midday/Night with manual override from the dock button, per-window focus memory, VPN status surface (preparation; hardware both-states verification is an on-device phase).

extension.summary: Roc OS household profiles — applicator and per-profile guard
extension.description: Applies the Roc household profile pack (E-Roc / Nue / Jamama / August) onto a v2.2.1 Roc Gold build using Kodi native profiles, and enforces per-profile rules at runtime: August's addon blocklist and settings/file-manager/addon-browser window guard, and the adult addon's per-profile disable outside E-Roc. No PIN is stored by this addon — profile locks and the adult PIN are set on-device by Eric.

extension.summary: Roc OS playback chain — every well at once
extension.description: Roc-owned movie/TV playback: asks every source well in parallel, merges the pour, fails over automatically when a source won't start. No third-party Python dependencies (stdlib only).
